title: Rear seatbelt recall and garage returns
summary: Feedback centers on rear seatbelt recalls and repeated garage visits, with some fragments also mentioning unrelated issues that limit a single coherent theme.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe disappointment about a rear seatbelt safety recall, a return for that recall within a few months, and repeated garage visits for other vehicle faults.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention a rear seatbelt recall, a booking for the recall alongside cruise-control failure, and a note about a narrow uphill garage without clear sentiment.

limitations: The sample is small and sentiment-stratified, so it should not be treated as representative.
This cluster mixes rear seatbelt recall comments with unrelated garage, cruise-control, taillight, and parking-context remarks.
Some fragments are too brief or contextual to determine clear sentiment.
